description: This file defines locale-specific information (Zimbabwean English) for the DateJS library, including date and time formats, day and month names, regex patterns, and prototype extensions for date manipulation.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components (hours, minutes, seconds, milliseconds) of a Date object to zero.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Returns current date with time cleared.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day based on its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month based on its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a given month and year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone abbreviation based on offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset string based on timezone name.
